issue: Initial stress and early-age strength lacked explicit input units.
resolution: Both inputs now explicitly MPa; 0.50 and 0.75 remain correct.

issue: One measured chord slope was labeled relative joint rotation.
resolution: Now apparentChordRotation; one gauge cannot determine relative joint rotation without both sides.

issue: Fourth-power span sensitivity needed the fixed line-load/stiffness/support assumptions.
resolution: Now fixes uniform q, EI and simple supports; ratio 1.4641 unchanged.

issue: Summed tangential joint travel needed circumferential versus diametral distinction.
resolution: Now circumferentialShortening, explicitly not diametral convergence.

issue: Ten-metre hydrostatic correction implied water density in a grout course.
resolution: Now conveyed-fluid density 1000 kg/m3 and instruction to recalculate for other grout density.

issue: D^(8/3) scaling needed geometrically similar effective circular passages.
resolution: Now explicitly full circular passages, same energy slope and roughness, not arbitrary deposition geometry.

issue: Settlement slope was not distinguished from structural distortion with rigid tilt removed.
resolution: Now meanSettlementSlope with explicit rigid-body tilt not removed. Definition clarification, not an arithmetic correction.

issue: RSS of independent standard uncertainties was called a survey closure residual.
resolution: Now combinedStandardUncertainty and explicitly not a measured closure residual.

issue: One element chord slope needed the adjacent orientation before interpreting joint rotation.
resolution: Now chordInclination plus explicit rigid-element and horizontal-neighbor condition.

issue: Relative joint rotation and opening difference needed explicit adjacent-element orientation.
resolution: Now rigid element beside a horizontal neighbor; 0.001 m opening difference remains correct.

issue: Rail settlement slope needed distinction from distortion and track twist.
resolution: Now meanSettlementSlope with rigid tilt not removed and not track twist.

issue: Final angular drift times full length could be confused with integrated path error.
resolution: Now finalAngleProjection explicitly applies final angle over whole length and excludes time-integrated path interpretation.
